name: multica
title_zh: 让人类与AI智能体在同一张作战图上协作
tagline_zh: 开会时AI不是旁观者，而是能领任务的同事。自托管、开源，把分散的agent收编成一支听指挥的队伍。
tagline_en: AI agents stop being bystanders in your meetings—they get tasks. Self-hosted, open-source, one chain of command.
desc_en: Make humans and AI agents work as one team — open-source and self-hostable.
why_zh: 它不是又一个agent框架，而是给人和agent共用的协作层：人类下指令、agent领活。
why_en: Not another agent framework—a shared ops layer where humans assign, agents pick up, and progress is mutually visible. Manage AI.
limit_zh: 只解决协作编排，不提供单个agent的推理能力；需要你自己已有可调用的agent或工具。若团队只有一人且无多agent。
limit_en: Orchestration only—no built-in agent brains. You must already have agents/tools to call. Solo devs with one agent will find little value.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。
